name: Hokuetsu Corporation
summary: Hokuetsu Corporation manufactures and sells paper products in Japan, Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Pulp and Paper Business and Packaging and Paper Processing Business segments. The company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of paper containers and liquid containers, as well as manufacture, processing, and sale of paper products; and wood chips, timber, construction, transportation and warehousing, and waste paper wholesale businesses.
